summary: Simone Brunozzi, Italian, living in San Francisco, Technology Evangelist at Amazon Web Services, former employee at AWS for 6+ years, strong interest in cloud computing, experienced public speaker (500+ talks), advocate for effective teaching methods, passionate about beekeeping, has a father-son relationship with his dad, critical of food quality in San Francisco compared to Italy, engaged in discussions about social issues and political matters, has lived in Singapore for 2.5 years, interested in virtual worlds (Second Life), and has a background in computer science.
